description: This file defines the SecureSocketPort class and its nested classes, including Certificate and Handler, which manage SSL/TLS socket connections, certificates, and validation within the WPEFramework Crypto namespace. It declares interfaces for secure socket operations, certificate handling, and validation callbacks.

classes.name: SecureSocketPort
classes.description: Represents a secure SSL/TLS socket port with capabilities for connection management, data transmission, and certificate validation within the WPEFramework.

classes.name: SecureSocketPort::Certificate
classes.description: Encapsulates an X.509 certificate and its associated context, providing methods to retrieve issuer, subject, validity period, hostname validation, and verification.

classes.name: SecureSocketPort::IValidator
classes.description: Interface for custom certificate validation logic, with a virtual destructor and a pure virtual Validate method.

classes.name: SecureSocketPort::Handler
classes.description: Internal class managing socket connection states, data transfer, and callback handling, derived from Core::SocketPort.

methods.name: SecureSocketPort::Certificate::Issuer
methods.description: Returns the issuer of the certificate.

methods.name: SecureSocketPort::Certificate::Subject
methods.description: Returns the subject of the certificate.

methods.name: SecureSocketPort::Certificate::ValidFrom
methods.description: Returns the start time of the certificate's validity period.

methods.name: SecureSocketPort::Certificate::ValidTill
methods.description: Returns the end time of the certificate's validity period.

methods.name: SecureSocketPort::Certificate::ValidHostname
methods.description: Checks if the certificate's hostname matches the expected hostname.

methods.name: SecureSocketPort::Certificate::Verify
methods.description: Verifies the certificate and returns success or error message.

methods.name: SecureSocketPort::Handler::Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the handler, setting up the socket connection.

methods.name: SecureSocketPort::Handler::Read
methods.description: Reads data from the socket buffer.

methods.name: SecureSocketPort::Handler::Write
methods.description: Writes data to the socket buffer.

methods.name: SecureSocketPort::Handler::Open
methods.description: Opens the socket connection with a specified wait time.

methods.name: SecureSocketPort::Handler::Close
methods.description: Closes the socket connection with a specified wait time.

methods.name: SecureSocketPort::Handler::Callback
methods.description: Sets a callback validator for certificate validation.

methods.name: SecureSocketPort::Callback
methods.description: Sets the validator callback for the socket port.

methods.name: SecureSocketPort::IsOpen
methods.description: Checks if the socket is open.

methods.name: SecureSocketPort::IsClosed
methods.description: Checks if the socket is closed.

methods.name: SecureSocketPort::IsSuspended
methods.description: Checks if the socket is suspended.

methods.name: SecureSocketPort::HasError
methods.description: Checks if the socket has an error.

methods.name: SecureSocketPort::LocalId
methods.description: Returns the local identifier of the socket.

methods.name: SecureSocketPort::RemoteId
methods.description: Returns the remote identifier of the socket.

methods.name: SecureSocketPort::LocalNode
methods.description: Sets the local node information.

methods.name: SecureSocketPort::RemoteNode
methods.description: Sets the remote node information.

methods.name: SecureSocketPort::RemoteNode (getter)
methods.description: Returns the remote node information.

methods.name: SecureSocketPort::Open
methods.description: Opens the socket connection.

methods.name: SecureSocketPort::Close
methods.description: Closes the socket connection.

methods.name: SecureSocketPort::Trigger
methods.description: Triggers socket events.
